title: Mastering Tavern Games in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
text:
Learn how to win at Checkers, Nine-Man Morris, and Fanorona in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced to earn the 'Grandmaster' trophy or achievement.
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced offers a thrilling open-world experience, but sometimes, you might want to take a break from the high seas and assassinations.
That's where tavern games come in. Each tavern brawl you win unlocks the tavern and grants access to three unique games: Checkers, Nine-Man Morris, and Fanorona. Mastering these games is not just fun, but also rewarding as it helps you earn the 'Grandmaster' trophy or achievement. Here's a guide on how to excel in each game.
Checkers, a classic 1v1 strategy game, requires you to move diagonally to 'jump' and capture your opponent's pieces. The goal is to eliminate all of your opponent's pieces. Nine-Man Morris is a grid-based game where you and your opponent place nine pieces each, aiming to create a 'mill' (three in a row) to remove one of your opponent's pieces.
Fanorona, played on a 9x5 board, involves moving along intersecting lines to capture your opponent's pieces, aiming to eliminate all of them in a single sequence. Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is currently available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC
